pages.text: Every spent $(l:nuclear/fuel_rod)Fuel Rod$(/l) becomes a $(l)Depleted Fuel Rod$(): nuclear waste. Left untreated it makes the area around it $(l)radioactive$(), and radiation makes people and animals sick. Treat it in a $(l:nuclear/waste_reprocessor)Waste Reprocessor$(/l).
Radiation is measured in $(l)Rad$() and builds up chunk by chunk (16x16 columns of the world).
pages.title: What contaminates

pages.text: $(li)Depleted Fuel Rods $(l)carried$() by a player, $(l)stored$() in a chest or any container (storage blocks of other mods included), or $(l)lying on the ground$(). Every rod adds $(l)2.5 Rad every 5 seconds$() to its chunk. A single rod in your inventory makes your chunk unsafe in about a minute.

$(li)A $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l) whose $(l)waste slots are full$(): the spent rods wait in the core and it $(l)leaks$().$(br)$(li)A $(l)meltdown$(): up to $(l)400 Rad$() over a 5x5 chunk area, worst at the core.
Waste is $(l)shielded$() inside the reactor's waste slots, a Reactor Port and any CyberFarm machine, such as the Waste Reprocessor. Stored waste only counts while a player is within 2 chunks.
Radiation fades by itself once the source is gone. A small leak is gone in a few minutes; a meltdown site takes much longer.

$(li)$(l)below 20 Rad$(): harmless$(br)$(li)$(l)20 Rad$(): $(l)Radiation Sickness I$(): hunger, and damage every 3 seconds$(br)$(li)$(l)50 Rad$(): the land $(l)withers$(): grass dries to dirt, plants wilt into dead bushes, leaves fall
pages.title: What it does

pages.text: $(li)$(l)100 Rad$(): $(l)Radiation Sickness II$(): also weakness, damage every 1.5 seconds$(br)$(li)$(l)300 Rad$(): $(l)Radiation Sickness III$(): also nausea, damage more than once a second$(br)Radiation Sickness hits players and mobs alike and goes through normal armor.

$(li)A $(l:nuclear/hazmat_suit)Hazmat Suit$(/l) keeps it out: each piece a quarter, the full suit all of it.$(br)$(li)A $(l:nuclear/geiger_counter)Geiger Counter$(/l) tells you how much there is.$(br)$(li)Move waste with hoppers instead of carrying it, and treat it in a $(l:nuclear/waste_reprocessor)Waste Reprocessor$(/l).
pages.title: Staying safe

pages.text: $(li)Withering land can be turned off in the common config ($(o)Radiation Withers Land$()).
